utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can firm up the repair drive timing. What works for you, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure yet—maybe after 3 works for me. I might be missing something, but that seems fine.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still on — I’m keeping track of the drop-off spot if you need it, and I can bring a few tools too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — the community hall works for me. I’ll keep everyone posted as we lock down the timing and tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll head to the community hall and help sort the timing there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m talking about the neighborhood repair drive—we need to sort out the jobs and pick a time to meet. Could we keep it simple and set a clear plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — let’s keep it simple. I can list the jobs and send a couple time options for us to choose from.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I mean the neighborhood repair drive at the community center lot, and I’m still planning to come by around 10 with a drill if I have one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep a running list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start inviting neighbors and share the list as it grows.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the coordination part is fine—can you keep track of who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can keep track of who’s bringing what and note any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s set, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I can pass that along. What drop-off time should I tell folks for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I keep losing the spots. Could you remind me of the drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — it’s at the community center parking lot off Maple, by the rear entrance.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — could you help keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that quietly and keep track of the supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Dane — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping things organized, and I can share your part if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’d like to keep my part low-key for now. Sunday at the community center works, and I can help quietly.
